title: Design System: Micro-Utilitarian — Danielle Hon Portfolio

display.purpose: Hero name and big case titles, uppercase. Capped at 96px.

headline.purpose: Section titles; card numerals share the voice.

body.purpose: Reading copy in Switzer; leads step up to 17-18px in Body Soft.

label.purpose: Mono kickers, codes, nav, spec keys, chips — always teal, uppercase.

motion.name: blink
motion.purpose: The rust status dot — the system's only ambient motion.

motion.name: card-hover
motion.purpose: Tonal fill shift (paper -> panel) on card hover.

motion.name: cat-flip
motion.purpose: Hero mark flip-book: three ink cats hard-cut through on a 1.8s loop, matching the micrographics version and rhyming with the blink dot.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion, all animation and transition are disabled globally.

surfaces.name: header-blur
surfaces.purpose: Sticky instrument-bar header; the one translucent surface.

surfaces.name: paper-texture
surfaces.value: fractalNoise grain @ 0.045 opacity + radial plotting dots @ 9% over #E7EAEC
surfaces.purpose: Very low-contrast paper texture on the body; must never compete with the hairline layout.

components.name: Primary Link Button
components.description: Bordered monospace CTA (case-study links); fills rust on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-block; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:0.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#17150F; background:transparent; padding:8px 14px; border:1px solid rgba(23,21,15,0.9); border-radius:0; text-decoration:none; transition:background 0.15s, color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background:#B83C24; color:#E7EAEC; border-color:#B83C24; outline:none; }

components.name: Status Stamp
components.description: Rotated rubber-stamp status marker with a blinking rust dot. One per hero.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; border:1.5px solid #B83C24; color:#B83C24; padding:6px 13px; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:0.16em; text-transform:uppercase; transform:rotate(-1.4deg); border-radius:0; } .ds-stamp-dot { width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:#B83C24; display:inline-block; animation:ds-blink 1.8s steps(1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-blink { 0%,60%{opacity:1} 61%,100%{opacity:0.2} } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){ .ds-stamp-dot{animation:none} }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Static mono tag; tiles with negative margins into a ruled block.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-block; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:0.1em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#17150F; padding:5px 11px; border:1px solid rgba(23,21,15,0.15); border-radius:0; margin:0 -1px -1px 0; }

components.description: Instrument-bar nav item; hairline left-border divider, hover flips to rust.

narrative.overview: A maker's specimen catalogue: the work numbered, coded, and filed the way Margiela files a garment or Muji files a product — as a specification, not an advertisement. Utilitarian's hard modular grid and giant Space Grotesk numerals are drawn in micrographics' hairlines on warm paper, so the page reads like a precision data sheet produced by someone with an atelier's restraint. The voice is precise, clever, understated — cleverness in a catalogue number, a rubber-stamp status, a monospace readout, never in effects that slow the reader.
keyCharacteristics: Hard modular grid with shared hairline borders; sections divided by full-weight rules
Warm bone paper (#E7EAEC) with a barely-there fibre-grain + plotting-dot texture
Three-voice type system: giant Space Grotesk numerals, IBM Plex Mono labels, Switzer body
Rust (#B83C24) as a scarce accent — the one stamp, status, hover, and key CTA
Flat by default; depth from line weight, with only a subtle hover lift
Zero border-radius everywhere except the status dot

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: Rust is a stamp, not a theme. It may carry the status mark, hover states, system IDs, and key CTAs — but if rust starts filling backgrounds or coloring body text, it has stopped being a stamp. Keep it a minority voice on every screen.

rules.name: The Line-Not-Slab Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn in ink at 90% or lighter, never pure #000. The grid should feel etched, not printed as a black bar.

rules.name: The 96px Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Display type never exceeds 96px (6rem) at its clamp max. Above that the page is shouting, not designing. The current hero name clamps to 104px — bring it to 96px on the next pass.

rules.name: The One-Job Rule
rules.body: Space Grotesk numbers, Plex Mono labels, Switzer prose. A label never appears in Switzer; body copy never appears in mono. The three voices stay in their lanes.

rules.name: The Flat-With-a-Lift Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest — depth comes from lines, not shadows. State is allowed to lift: cards shift to Panel on hover and a small translateY is permitted, but any resting box-shadow on a card, button, or input is forbidden.

dos: Do draw structure with lines: full-weight Grid Line (#17150FE6) between sections, Hairline (#17150F26) within them. The grid is the design.
Do keep Signal Rust (#B83C24) a minority accent — stamp, status dot, hover, system IDs, key CTAs — and let its scarcity carry the weight.
Do keep every corner at 0px radius (the status dot is the only exception).
Do hold body measure near 65ch with max-width: 520-680px.
Do keep the three type voices in their lanes: Space Grotesk numerals, IBM Plex Mono labels, Switzer body.
Do convey state with a tonal shift to Panel and a small hover lift — never a resting shadow.
donts: Don't let this drift into a generic template portfolio — hero photo over three identical cards with buzzwords. The catalogue format is the anti-template.
Don't ship AI slop tells: gradient text, cream-plus-gradient palettes, or tracked all-caps eyebrows above every section.
Don't turn this into a corporate/SaaS landing page: no big-metric hero template, no repeated feature-card grids, no enterprise blue.
Don't overdesign — no decorative animation, glassmorphism as default, or effects that slow the reader.
Don't exceed 96px on display type, and never tighten display letter-spacing past -0.04em.
Don't add a resting box-shadow to any card, button, or input.
Don't color body text or fill backgrounds with rust; it is a stamp, not a theme.
